# India Eurasia Research Forum (IERF)

> The India Eurasia Research Forum provides evidence‑based policy research and analysis on geopolitics, security, economics, and civilizational ties across Eurasia.

The platform hosts research papers, regional analysis, a digital heritage archive, dialogue events, and invites contributors to submit writings on Indo‑Eurasian affairs.

## Home
- [Home – overview of IERF](https://indiaeurasia.org): Landing page with summary of research focus and latest updates.

## About & Team
- [About – mission and background](https://www.indiaeurasia.org/about): Information on IERF’s purpose, history, and objectives.  
- [Our People – staff and scholars](https://www.indiaeurasia.org/our-people): Profiles of researchers and contributors.

## Research
- [Research – publications overview](https://www.indiaeurasia.org/research): Collection of research papers and analysis across topics.  
- [Digital Silk Road](https://www.indiaeurasia.org/research/digital-silk-road): Paper on digital infrastructure linking Eurasia.  
- [Intercultural Dialogue in Practice](https://www.indiaeurasia.org/research/intercultural-dialogue-practice): An insightful exploration of interculturality and cultural diplomacy.  
- [India‑Chabahar](https://www.indiaeurasia.org/research/india-chabahar-final): Study of India’s involvement in the Chabahar port project.  
- [NUR Stories from Eurasia](https://www.indiaeurasia.org/research/nur-stories-from-eurasia): Collection of narratives on Eurasian cultural ties.  
- [Calculus of Eurasia](https://www.indiaeurasia.org/research/calculus-of-eurasia): Analytical paper on Eurasian geopolitical dynamics.  

## Digital Archive
- [DigiEurasia – digital heritage archive](https://www.indiaeurasia.org/digieurasia): Archive of historical documents and digital resources.

## Events
- [Volga to Ganga event](https://www.indiaeurasia.org/events/volga-to-ganga): Details of the Volga‑to‑Ganga dialogue series.  
- [IERF Talks](https://www.indiaeurasia.org/events/ierf-talks): Series of talks and seminars hosted by IERF.

## Contribute
- [Write for Us – contribution guidelines](https://www.indiaeurasia.org/write-for-us): Guidelines for submitting articles and research.
